contract.reader: An engineering student or engineer following the Sensor Systems series who has a conditioned analog voltage and needs to know what the converter does to it
contract.problem: Choosing a sampling rate, an anti-aliasing filter and a converter resolution and architecture, and knowing what errors each contributes
contract.outcome: Explain aliasing and the sampling theorem, size an anti-aliasing filter against the converter's resolution, compute the quantization step, its uncertainty and the ideal SQNR, read static and dynamic converter specifications (INL, DNL, SINAD, ENOB, jitter) and choose between SAR, delta-sigma and other architectures
contract.contribution: Ties sampling and quantization to the series' running load-cell channel and to the GUM rectangular-distribution uncertainty of entry 1, with worked numbers at each step
contract.evidence: Derivations and worked numbers in the text; one generated figure; IEEE Std 1241-2023, Kester (2005), Oppenheim and Schafer (2010), Pallas-Areny and Webster (2001)
contract.limitations: Delta-sigma noise shaping treated qualitatively; no code; DAC covered in one paragraph

findings.location: Section 1.1, aliasing figure at 360 px (mobile-light-05, mobile-dark-05)
findings.problem: At 360 px the figure's axis labels and legend are about 6 px high, and its right edge (last sample at t = 1 s, end of the legend) is cut.
findings.whyItMatters: The caption repeats the key, but the figure's own labels are unreadable on a phone.
findings.action: In scripts/generate-diagrams.py move the legend into the caption or onto two lines and raise the label size so it renders at least at caption size at 360 px; regenerate.
findings.acceptance: At 360 px every label of the figure is legible at caption size and the legend is fully visible.

findings.problem: At 360 px the SQNR display ends at '≈ 6.0', hiding the result 6.02 N + 1.76 dB; the conclusion of the 1.1 identity is also cut.
findings.whyItMatters: The display the section exists for shows no result on a phone (it is restated in prose and in the summary).
findings.action: Put 'SQNR ≈ 6.02 N + 1.76 dB' on its own line (aligned block) and split the 1.1 identity at its second equals sign.
findings.acceptance: At 360 px the full SQNR approximation and the conclusion of the 1.1 identity are visible without sideways scrolling.

findings.problem: The three references to the series' first entry, Measurement Systems and Sensor Characteristics, are plain text, including the one that relies on its Type B uncertainty.
findings.whyItMatters: A reader arriving from search or from the DSP series cannot tell which page is meant.
findings.action: Link the first mention in 3.2 to /blog/measurement-systems-and-sensor-characteristics#52-evaluating-uncertainty.
findings.acceptance: On the live page 'the first entry' in Section 3.2 is a working link to the first entry of Sensor Systems.
